function.name: view_image
function.description: View a PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image (max 8 MiB); sends it to the model.

function.name: read
function.description: Read UTF-8 file lines; offset is 1-based, default limit 200.

function.name: write
function.description: Create or overwrite a file. Requires approval.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace exactly one occurrence of old with new. If old appears multiple times, provide line_number to disambiguate. Requires approval.

line_number.description: Line number (1-based) where the replacement should occur; required when old appears multiple times

function.name: list
function.description: List files and directories in a workspace directory (default root).

function.name: download
function.description: Prepare workspace files as a ZIP. Defaults to the whole workspace. Browser shows a save link; native saves under .i/downloads/.

function.name: shell
function.description: Run a shell command with timeout. Requires approval. NOT sandboxed.
